title: $Lf^*$ preserves bounded constructible complexes
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring and let $f\colon X\to Y$ be a morphism of the
setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. If $K\in D(\Mod_{\Lambda_Y})$ is bounded constructible
([sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]), then so is $Lf^*K\in D(\Mod_{\Lambda_X})$
([sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]).

proof.text: By [det-prop-sfb-module-pullback-exact-main], $F=f^*$ is additive and exact. Its total derived functor is $Lf^*$ by [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. The exact-derived comparison [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-functor] and cohomology formula [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below] give $H^q(Lf^*K)\cong f^*H^q(K)$ for every integer $q$.

source.place: First two sentences: exactness, termwise derivation and cohomology

proof.text: Choose a cohomological interval $[a,b]$ for $K$ by [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. Outside it $H^q(K)=0$; additivity sends zero to zero, so step 1 gives the same interval for $Lf^*K$.

Fix $q$ and $M=H^q(K)$. By [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible, def-sfb-constructible-module], choose strata $j_a\colon Y_a\to Y$ with raw restrictions locally finitely presented. By [lem-sfb-alpha-iso], $\alpha_{j_a}$ is invertible. Apply [lem-sfb-lfp-scalar-isomorphism] and [def-sfb-module-upper-star] to obtain locally finitely presented normalized restrictions $M_a=j_a^*M$ over $\Lambda_{Y_a}$.

source.place: Finite stratification sentence; raw versus normalized restrictions

proof.text: By [lemma-constructible-pullback-stratification], $X_a=X\times_Y Y_a$, with immersions $i_a$ and projections $f_a$, form a finite stratification of $X$, and $f\circ i_a=j_a\circ f_a$.

Apply [lem-sfb-local-finite-presentation-inverse-image] to each $f_a,M_a$: the base-changed cover and presentations of the same ranks give raw local finite presentation over $f_a^*\Lambda_{Y_a}$. Since $\alpha_{f_a}$ is invertible [lem-sfb-alpha-iso], [lem-sfb-lfp-scalar-isomorphism] and [def-sfb-module-upper-star] give local finite presentation of $f_a^*M_a$ over $\Lambda_{X_a}$.

source.place: Base-changed cover and finite-free cokernel presentations

proof.text: Composition [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback] and step 4 give $i_a^*f^*M\cong(f\circ i_a)^*M=(j_a\circ f_a)^*M\cong f_a^*j_a^*M=f_a^*M_a$. Compose the cokernel presentation isomorphisms with this isomorphism. By [lem-sfb-alpha-iso, lem-sfb-lfp-scalar-isomorphism], restriction along $\alpha_{i_a}$ gives locally finitely presented raw restrictions over $i_a^*\Lambda_X$. Thus [def-sfb-constructible-module] makes $f^*M$ constructible.

source.place: Pullbacks compose; return to raw constructibility

proof.text: For every $q$, step 6 makes $f^*H^q(K)$ constructible. Composing its presentation isomorphisms with step 1 gives constructibility of $H^q(Lf^*K)$. The bound from step 2 completes [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible].
